name: GreptimeDB
overview: A Rust-based TSDB designed specifically for cloud-edge observability. It unifies metrics and logs in a single query engine.
details: GreptimeDB is engineered to handle massive scale while maintaining a very low footprint on edge devices. It utilizes a unified SQL/PromQL interface, making it highly versatile for developers.
For OpenClaw, it is an excellent Tier 2 alternative if you require native SQL access to your telemetry data rather than strictly relying on PromQL syntax.
